Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.history.simulation

package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.history.simulation
Simulation implementations for historical room usage data access.

This package provides file-based implementations of the HistoryAPI interface, along with supporting data models. These implementations are designed for development, testing, and demonstration purposes, simulating a historical data repository using JSON files.

Key Components:

  • FileHistoryAPI - File-based implementation reading historical data from JSON files
  • RoomHistoryDTO - Data model representing complete usage history for a single room
  • UsageEntryDTO - Individual timestamp/occupancy measurement within a room's history

Purpose:

The simulation package enables the Occupi application to:

  • Development and Testing: Work with realistic historical data without requiring a production database
  • Demonstrations: Showcase analytics and reporting features with pre-populated sample data
  • Prototyping: Rapidly iterate on features that depend on historical data
  • Education: Understand data structures and API contracts with tangible examples

Data Format:

Historical data is stored in JSON files with the following structure: 


 [
   {
     "roomId": "ROOM_A",
     "historyUsage": [
       {
         "date": "2024-01-15T09:00:00",
         "occupancy": 15
       },
       {
         "date": "2024-01-15T10:00:00",
         "occupancy": 23
       }
     ]
   },
   {
     "roomId": "ROOM_B",
     "historyUsage": [
       {
         "date": "2024-01-15T09:00:00",
         "occupancy": 8
       }
     ]
   }
 ]

Implementation Details:

FileHistoryAPI

  • Data Source: JSON files on the file system
  • Loading Strategy: Reads and deserializes data on demand
  • Caching: Data is processed per request (no internal caching)
  • Thread Safety: Stateless after construction, thread-safe
  • Error Handling: Returns empty collections on errors, logs to stderr

Data Models

  • RoomHistoryDTO: Java record, immutable, represents all historical data for one room
  • UsageEntryDTO: Java record, immutable, represents a single timestamp/occupancy pair

Integration:

This package integrates with the broader application through:

  • JsonReader: Utilizes the centralized JSON utility from JsonReader for file deserialization
  • HistoryAPI: Implements the contract defined in the api package
  • RoomUsageAnalyzer: Consumed by analytics components for generating insights and visualizations

Usage Example:


 // Initialize with default JSON file
 HistoryAPI historyAPI = new FileHistoryAPI();

 // Or specify a custom file path
 HistoryAPI historyAPI = new FileHistoryAPI("data/custom-history.json");

 // Retrieve historical data
 Map<LocalDateTime, Integer> roomHistory = historyAPI.getRoomUsageHistory("ROOM_A");

 // Process the data
 roomHistory.forEach((timestamp, occupancy) -> {
     System.out.printf("Room had %d people at %s%n", occupancy, timestamp);
 });

File Location:

Default historical data files are located at:

  • Development: src/main/resources/jsonData/historyData/
  • Testing: src/test/resources/jsonData/historyData/

Limitations:

  • Not suitable for production use with large datasets (no pagination)
  • Read-only; cannot write historical data back to files
  • Limited query capabilities (only retrieval by room ID)
  • No built-in caching mechanism (reads file on each request)

Future Enhancements:

Potential improvements for production readiness:

  • Add internal caching with configurable TTL
  • Support for date range queries
  • Aggregation capabilities (hourly, daily, weekly summaries)
  • Write capabilities for data persistence
  • Migration to actual database implementation

Testing Support:

The simulation package is particularly useful for testing because:

  • Test data can be easily created and modified in JSON files
  • No external dependencies (database, network) required
  • Fast initialization and teardown for unit tests
  • Predictable, repeatable test scenarios
